in_marathi.name: Nishar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nisha', meaning night or darkness. In Hindu mythology, Nishar refers to the lord of the night or Shiva, who is often depicted as the destroyer of darkness and ignorance. This name symbolizes strength, power, and protection against fear and adversity.
